scope.experience: A customer-facing support agent answering from configured business knowledge with human handoff
scope.task: Ask a support question covered by supplied help articles, then an unsupported request that should be handed to a person.
scope.configuration: Configured knowledge-base chat with escalation; external refund/account actions and autonomous operational changes are disabled or excluded. No actual customer deployment was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: The end customer using support, not the administrator configuring the deployment

conversational.rationale: Customers can ask natural-language follow-ups while the conversation remains bounded by support intent, business rules and escalation paths.
conversational.uncertainty: Channel and configured conversation rules may make a deployment more guided than this estimate.

specialization.rationale: A configured business knowledge base and customer-service workflow create a strongly task/domain-focused assistant.
specialization.uncertainty: The breadth and quality of the supplied business knowledge vary by deployment.

autonomy.rationale: After setup, Fin handles customer conversations and can hand off cases without a human approving every answer.
autonomy.uncertainty: The score is for answer-and-handoff automation. Procedures that change external records would require separate assessment.

accessibility.rationale: From the end customer's perspective, familiar support channels can provide help without learning an administrator or developer interface.
accessibility.uncertainty: Service deployment, supported languages and handoff availability determine actual reach; administrative setup is a separate audience.

explainability.rationale: Customers see an answer and may receive supporting information, but the documented administrative observability is not assumed to be fully visible to them.
explainability.uncertainty: Customer-visible source links, explanations and decision boundaries depend on deployment and were not tested.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no customer deployment or performance tests. Scope: Fin knowledge-base support chat with human handoff; excludes external account/refund actions and Operator. Audience perspective: end customer. Scores are design estimates, not vendor resolution-rate claims. Source: https://fin.ai/service .
